desc: Implement DSU with bitmask parity: parent[], size[], xor-to-parent mask[]; iterative find with path compression returning (root, mask); union(x, y, w) returning False on any bit contradiction.
Parse input via sys.stdin.buffer.read; store X, Y, Z lists; handle M=0.
Union all constraints with full Z_i as parity mask; on contradiction print -1 and exit.
Single pass over nodes: find root and parity mask; group counts per root per bit (cnt0/cnt1 via dict-of-arrays or per-root arrays of 30-bit counters).
Per root and bit k: choose root bit minimizing ones (min(cnt1, cnt0)); record chosen root mask.
Reconstruct A_i = parity_mask(i) XOR chosen_mask(root(i)); output space-separated; verify against samples mentally.

Verify correctness: trace samples 1-3, audit find() path compression (the two-pass accumulation), union parity assignment direction (rx under ry vs ry under rx), and edge cases (M=0, X_i=Y_i with Z_i≠0, Z_i with bit 29 set).
